question.text: Which of the following is correct?

options.text: Evaporation of water causes an increase in disorder of the system
Melting of ice causes a decrease in randomness of the system
Condensation of steam causes an increase in disorder of the system
There is practically no change in the randomness of the system when water is evaporated

solution.text: Water evaporates into steam. In this physical state its disorder or randomness increases.
